description: A clipper: the signal passes through untouched between two levels and is flattened at everything above and below them

params.text: Sets the level the signal is flattened at from above, -10V to 10V
Sets the level the signal is flattened at from below, -10V to 10V
Scales the HIGH CV input, 0 to 1, before that voltage is added to the HIGH knob
Scales the LOW CV input, 0 to 1, before that voltage is added to the LOW knob

inputs.text: Moves the upper flattening level, a volt per volt at the full HIGH CV setting, added to the HIGH knob
Moves the lower flattening level, a volt per volt at the full LOW CV setting, added to the LOW knob

outputs.text: The input with everything above the upper level and below the lower level flattened to those levels

notes: the knobs come up at 10V and -10V, which is the whole range Rack uses, so the module passes a signal through unchanged until one of them is turned in.
with the lower level set above the upper one the output rests at the lower level and the input is not heard at all.
nothing limits a knob plus its CV, so either level can be driven well past 10V and stop clipping altogether.
the module is monophonic. Only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and the output carries one channel.
